about: Chapter 92 tells how Azarias and the Israelite company renew David’s kingship at Zion with the anointing and a festival, set the law for the court, and draw the boundaries of the Ethiopian king’s realm. Chapter 93 records the laws and names written down three months after Zion’s arrival, then turns to Rome: its faith, once right, was spoiled by Nestorius and Arius, while Ethiopia holds the true faith of the apostles.

sentences.l: And-said Azarias: Bring-ye jubilee and-let-us-go to Zion, and-there let-us-renew kingdom-his for-our-lord David.
sentences.i: And Azarias said, “Bring the jubilee horn (?), and let us go to Zion, and there let us renew the kingdom of our lord David.”
sentences.n: Azarias, the priest’s son who came with Menelik from Jerusalem, leads the renewal of David’s reign at Zion (the Ark’s tent). አምጽኡ is a plural command; ነሐድስ (“let us renew”) is a first-person plural wish from the same root as the title. ኢዮቤል is “jubilee,” so the jubilee horn or trumpet (?); it is not taken as a name. ወንሖር is ወ‑ “and” + ንሖር “let us go” (1cp jussive of ሖረ, as in the published chs. 46–48 and 62–63), with ኀበ ጽዮን “to Zion” as its goal. ወ‑ “and,” ለ‑ marks the person (“for/of David”).

sentences.n: A long list of the festival: instruments, games with horse, shield and bow, and the whole population in order. Uncertain points: ብዕዛ is not clear to me, perhaps a pipe or trumpet (?); በበ፷፻ is “each by 60 × 100,” read as six thousand (?); ቄፋዝ is a cloth term in the published chs. 51–52, but after “goes up to” it must be a place or hall (?); ታዕካ መንግሥት is as in ch. 25–26, “the ታዕካ of the kingdom,” a royal palace or hall (?); እለ ይከይድ ንጉሥ ዳዊት is awkward: እለ is plural but ይከይድ singular, and ከይደ “walk, tread” (ኬደ in ch. 24) has no preposition here, so “those among whom King David walks” is a guess (?). ለ‑ on ለአዋልደ ጽዮን marks the object (“whom he chose, the daughters of Zion”) or means “from among” them. ተውኔት “revelry, ritual play” (the house word), ማኅሌት “choral song.” This unit is 44 words and has no ፤ inside to cut at.

sentences.i: And then, when he had finished what was made law, and just as they had seen in Jerusalem, they made in the House of Zion a law for the chosen ones of the kingdom, for those within and those outside, for the people, for the አላዳስ (?), for the cities, for the lands (?), and for all their peoples and their traders (?); so they ordained.
sentences.n: The court now sets up a law copied from the Jerusalem pattern. Note: the source prints ሕዘቢሆ ፡ ሙ with a stray wordspace; it is ሕዘቢሆሙ “their peoples” (ሕዝብ, plural ሕዘብ, + ‑ሆሙ). sentences.i: And these are the boundaries of the land of the kingdom of the king of Ethiopia: from the east, starting at the city of Gaza in the land of Judah, that is Jerusalem; its border is the sea of Jericho, and it passes along the shore of the sea to Liba and Saba; and its border goes down to Bisis and Asnet; and its border is the land of the dark-skinned peoples and the naked ones (?); and it goes up Mount Kebereneyon into the sea of darkness, that is, the west; and its border crosses to Phenuel and Sifala (?); and its border is the regions of the garden, fertile in grain and rich in cattle, and Phoenicia (?); and its border goes to Zawl (?), and it passes the sea of India, and its border reaches the sea of Tarshish, and by its measure (?) the land of Midian, until it comes to the land of Gaza; and its border is where it first began;
sentences.n: The claimed frontiers of the Ethiopian king’s realm, drawn as a circuit that closes on Gaza. This is one 75-word unit because the text has no ፤ inside it; the ወ‑ clauses could be cut but would not end at a mark. ሞጻእት “going-out, boundary” returns with each clause (ሞጻእቱ “its boundary”). ሠረቃዊ “eastern” (from ሠረቀ “rise”). ባሕረ ጽልመት, the “sea of darkness,” is the western ocean. Place names are given in Geʿez form and several I cannot identify: Liba and Saba (Libya and Sheba? (?)), Bisis, Asnet, ዕሩቃን (ዕሩቅ “naked,” plural, read as a people beside ጸሊማን), ኬቤሬኔዮን, ሲፋላ, ዛውል (all (?)); ፌኔኤል may be Peniel (Genesis 32:30) or Phoenicia (?). አግዋረ ገነት “regions of the garden” and መስመረ እክል “thriving of grain” are my best reading (?). ትትኃለፍ and ተዐዲ are “it passes / crosses.”

sentences.n: The turn to the story of the fall of Rome’s faith. ፻ወ፴ is “100 and 30.” ዘእምትካት is read as “from of old” (?), as እምትካት is in ch. 44 (ትካት “establishment, foundation” (?)). ዕድው is “man” in ch. 35, which does not suit ዕድዉ ለሰብእ; I read it as “enemy, adversary” from the context (?). At ወአምጽኡ the subject becomes plural, “they brought,” after Satan’s singular verbs. አስሐቶሙ “he led them astray,” አሕሠምዋ “he spoiled it” (the ‑ዋ is feminine, for ሃይማኖት); ኑፋቄ “heresy.” በአፈ is “by the mouth of” (construct of አፍ “mouth”), so Nestorius is the speaker through whom Satan works. sentences.i: As David said: “And they spoke iniquity on high, and set their mouths in heaven, and their tongues roamed on the earth.” They themselves did not know where they had come from, and did not know where they are going; against their Creator they mock (?) with their tongues and blaspheme against his glory, though he is God, the Word of God;
sentences.n: Quotes Psalm 73:8–9 (Hebrew numbering; 72 in the Greek and Ethiopic counting): the arrogant set their mouth against heaven while their tongue walks through the earth. The words after “roamed on the earth” are the author’s own application to the heretics. አንሶሰወ “wander about”; ዘለሊሆሙ “of themselves.” ይውሕኩ is read “they mock / slander” (?); ይፀርፉ “they blaspheme.” በከመ ይቤ “as he said” introduces the quotation; እንዘ “while, although.” ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር is Christ as the Word (John 1:1).

sentences.i: He came down from the throne of his divinity and put on the flesh of Adam, and he is God, the Word, and in that flesh he was crucified so that he might redeem Adam in his ዕልወት (sense unknown (?)); and he ascended into heaven and sat on the throne of his divinity in that flesh which he took, and he will come again in glory to judge the living and the dead, and will repay each according to his deeds, for ever and ever, Amen. As for us, we believe thus and give worship to the Holy Trinity (?);
sentences.n: A creed in miniature: incarnation, crucifixion, ascension, return and judgment (compare the Nicene Creed). This is 46 words, just over the usual cut, but it has no ፤ inside to cut at. ከመ ይቤዝዎ is “that he may redeem him”: ይቤዝዎ is ይቤዝው (3ms subjunctive of ቤዘወ) + ‑ኦ “him,” with ለአዳም naming the one redeemed, so Christ is the subject. በዕልወቱ is unclear: በ‑ is “in/by,” not “from,” and ዕልወት might be “perversity” (?). ለዓለመ ዓለም “for the world of the world,” the standard “for ever and ever.” ‑ሰ in ወንሕነሰ marks the contrast “as for us.” ንገኒ “we bow to, worship” (ገነየ takes ለ‑ in the published parts; the spelling for ንግነይ is odd (?)).

(suffix -ሙ, 2mp, split from its word by the wordspace) · here completing ዐውዶ as ዐውዶሙ 'around them' (suffix -ሙ, 3mp) · here completing ሕዘቢሆ as ሕዘቢሆሙ 'their peoples' (suffix -ሙ, 3mp, split from its word by the wordspace)
glossary.ሚያዝያ: ሚያዝያ — Miyazya (name of the Ethiopian month, April)
glossary.ማክዳ: ማክዳ — Makeda (proper name, the Queen of Sheba)
glossary.ምልአ: ምልእ — fill, fullness (noun, construct 'fill-of'; ምልአ እደዊሁ 'the fill of his hands')
glossary.ምስፍና: ምስፍና — Məsfəna (place name), the same word as the common noun ምስፍና 'rule, lordship', from which the city's name is taken (?)
glossary.ምድያም: ምድያም — Midian (proper name; ንጉሠ ምድያም 'king of Midian')
glossary.ሞጻእተ: ሞጻእት — going-out, boundary, border (noun, fem.; construct 'boundary of')
glossary.ሠረቀ: ሠረቀ — it rose, dawned (3ms perfect, G, of sun and light) · as a noun in construct, 'the rising of, sunrise of' (እስከ ሠረቀ ህንድ 'to the sunrise of India') (?) · of a month, 'began' (አመ ሠረቀ ቀዳሚ ወርኅ 'on the day the first month began')
glossary.ሠርዑ: ሠርዐ — they ordained, set in order (3mp perfect, G, ś-r-ʿ)
glossary.ሠናያት: ሠናይ — good things (adjective used as noun, f. plural ሠናያት)
glossary.ሢመቱ: ሢመት — his order, appointment, rank (noun + -ሁ 'his', anticipating ለመልከ ጼዴቅ)
glossary.ሥጋ: ሥጋ — flesh, body (noun; construct 'flesh of') · 'meat' as food (ከመ ይብልዓ ሥጋ 'to eat meat'; ነሥአ ሥጋ 'took meat') · his body, with -ሁ (ሥጋሁ)
glossary.ርእዩ: ርእየ — see! (2mp imperative) · they saw (3mp perfect, ሶበ ርእዩ 'when they saw'; ch. 53)
glossary.ሮምያ: ሮምያ — Rome (proper name, variant of ሮም)
glossary.ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
glossary.ቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — first (adj.) · adverbial 'first' after ኀበ (ኀበ ቀዳሚ ተወጠነ 'where it first began')
glossary.ቀዳሚሰ: ቀዳሚ — at first (adjective ቀዳሚ used as adverb + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
glossary.ቄፋዝ: ቄፋዝ — unknown word, apparently a kind of thread or cloth used with gold; meaning from context (?) · after 'goes up to' (የዐርግ ውስተ ቄፋዝ 'he goes up to the ቄፋዝ'), apparently a place or hall rather than a cloth (?)
glossary.ቅብአ: ቅብእ — anointing (noun, construct 'anointing of'; verbal noun of ቀብአ)
glossary.በሀገረ: ሀገር — in the city of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በልሳኖሙ: ልሳን — with their tongue(s) (በ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በሐይቀ: ሐይቅ — on the shore of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በምድረ: ምድር — in the land of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በርትዕት: ርቱዕ — in the right, orthodox (በ- + adjective, fem. ርትዕት)
glossary.በስብሐት: ስብሐት — in glory, in praise (በ- + noun)
glossary.በስብከተ: ስብከት — in the preaching of (በ- + noun, fem.; construct)
glossary.በቃለ: ቃል — by the word of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በበ፷፻ወአዋልድ: ወለት — each by sixty hundred, and daughters (በበ 'each, by' distributive + numeral ፷፻, spoken ስሳ ምእት (səssa məʾət) 'sixty hundred', i.e. six thousand (?) + ወ- 'and' + plural አዋልድ of ወለት 'daughter') (?)
glossary.በቤተ: ቤት — in the house of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በነገረ: ነገር — in the speech of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በአፈ: አፍ — by the mouth of (በ- + noun, construct አፈ)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በዕልወቱ: ዕልወት — in his ዕልወት (በ- 'in, by' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; perhaps 'perversity'; sense unclear) (?)
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
glossary.በይእቲ: ይእቲ — on that, in that (በ- + 3fs pronoun/demonstrative 'she, that')
glossary.ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea') · accusative object or goal: 'reached the sea' (ወበጽሑ ባሕረ), 'crossed the sea' (ዐደዉ ባሕረ), 'came out of the sea' (ወወፅኡ ባሕረ), ch. 55 · construct 'sea of' (ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'the Sea of Erythra, the Red Sea')
glossary.ባሕሩ: ባሕር — its sea, the sea (noun + -ሁ '3ms its')
glossary.ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
glossary.ብሔረ: ብሔር — land, region (construct 'land of') · accusative 'a land' (ርሑቀ ብሔረ 'far, a land'; the construct reading is the alternative (?))
glossary.ተሐደሰ: ሐደሰ — it was renewed (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ሐደሰ)
glossary.ተሰቅለ: ሰቀለ — he was crucified, hanged (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ሰቀለ)
glossary.ተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — he arose, rose up (3m sg perfect, n-s-ʾ)
glossary.ተወጠነ: ወጠነ — it began, was begun (3ms perfect, tä-stem, w-ṭ-n)
glossary.ተውኔተ: ተውኔት — revelry (noun, fem.; construct 'revelry of' / accusative) (?)
glossary.ተገብረ: ገብረ — it was done, made (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ታርሞን: ታርሞን — Tarmon (name of a month, here the Greek name) (?)
glossary.ታዕካ: ታዕካ — unidentified word, perhaps a title, place or object (noun; the 'taʿka') (?)
glossary.ትነብር: ነበረ — she dwells, sits (3fs imperfect, n-b-r)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ነሐድስ: ሐደሰ — let us renew (1cp jussive, G, ḥ-d-s)
glossary.ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ነአምን: አምነ — we believe (1cp imperfect, G, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of') · accusative 'kings' as object (ያዐቢ ነገሥተ 'he makes kings great') · predicate 'as kings' (ኮኑ ነገሥተ 'they became kings', ?)
glossary.ንስጥሮስ: ንስጥሮስ — Nestorius (proper name; genitive after አፈ)
glossary.ንኡሶሙ: ንኡስ — their small ones, the small of them (adjective as noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article)
glossary.አምነ: አምነ — he believed (3ms perfect, G, ʾ-m-n); with the Roman Church understood, 'they believed' (?)
glossary.አምጽኡ: አምጽአ — bring! (2mp imperative, causative of መጽአ, ʾ-m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.አቤልሃ: አቤል — Abel (proper name; the ending -ሃ is unexplained) (?)
glossary.አኀው: አኅ — brothers (plural of አኅ, አኀው) · siblings, brother and sister together (፪ አኀው 'two siblings')
glossary.አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
glossary.አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
glossary.አግዋረ: አግዋር — regions, parts (plural noun; construct 'regions of'; sense from context) (?)
glossary.አፉሆሙ: አፍ — their mouths (noun, base አፉ- before suffixes + -ሆሙ '3mp their', accusative)
glossary.ኢየአምኑ: አምነ — they do not believe (ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ኢያእመሩ: አእመረ — they did not know (ኢ- + 3mp perfect, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ኢዮቤል: ኢዮቤል — jubilee, the jubilee horn (noun; also the personal name Joel, not meant here) (?)
glossary.እመንበረ: መንበር — from the throne of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እኁሁ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እክል: ክህለ — I can, I am able (1cs imperfect, k-h-l) · grain, produce (noun) in ዐውደ እክል 'threshing floor of grain'
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኬቤሬኔዮን: ኬቤሬኔዮን — Kebereneyon (proper name of a mount, unidentified) (?)
glossary.ክርስቶስኒ: ክርስቶስ — Christ also, Christ indeed (proper name + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ወለሕዝብ: ሕዝብ — and for the people (ወ- + ለ- + noun)
glossary.ወለሲፋላ: ሲፋላ — and to Sifala (ወ- + ለ- + proper name, unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወለበሓውርት: ብሔር — and for the lands, regions (ወ- + ለ- + plural በሓውርት of ብሔር; so read in ch. 54) (?)
glossary.ወለብሰ: ለብሰ — and he put on, wore (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, l-b-s)
glossary.ወለአህጉር: ሀገር — and for the cities (ወ- + ለ- + plural አህጉር of ሀገር)
glossary.ወለአላዳስ: አላዳስ — and for the አላዳስ (ወ- + ለ- + noun; unidentified, perhaps a class of people or a region) (?)
glossary.ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
glossary.ወለኵሉ: ኵሉ — and to all, for all (ወ- + ለ- + ኵሉ)
glossary.ወለዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and to his seed (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ሁ 'his')
glossary.ወለድራር: ድራር — and for the evening meal (ወ- + ለ- + noun)
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወመሰንቆ: መሰንቆ — and lyre (?) (ወ- + noun; a stringed instrument) (?)
glossary.ወሙታነ: ሙት — and dead ones (ወ- + noun, plural ሙታን, accusative)
glossary.ወማኅሌተ: ማኅሌት — and choral song, hymn (ወ- + noun, fem.; accusative)
glossary.ወሞጻእቱ: ሞጻእት — and its boundary (ወ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms its')
glossary.ወረደ: ወረደ — he went down, descended (3ms perfect, G, w-r-d) · ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
glossary.ወርኅ: ወርኅ — moon, month (noun; construct 'of the moon')
glossary.ወሳባ: ሳባ — and Saba (ወ- + proper name; Sheba? (?))
glossary.ወቀብእዎ: ቀብአ — and they anointed him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, q-b-ʾ + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወበቅሥፈቱ: ቅሥፈት — and by its extent, along its measure (ወ- + በ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ 'its'; sense from context; Dillmann's ቀሠፈ is 'strike') (?)
glossary.ወበአሚነ: አሚን — and in belief in (ወ- + በ- + verbal noun of አምነ; construct 'belief of')
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወበዘ: ዘ — and in that which, whereby (ወ- + በ- + relative ዘ)
glossary.ወበዘይመጽእ: ዘ — and in that which comes (ወ- + በ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect of መጽአ)
glossary.ወበይእቲ: ይእቲ — and through that, through her (ወ- + በ- + 3fs pronoun/demonstrative)
glossary.ወበግዕዝ: ግዕዝ — and in Geʿez (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበጽርእ: ጽርእ — and in Greek (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወብዕዛ: ብዕዛ — and ብዕዛ (?) (ወ- + noun; some musical instrument, unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወብዝኀተ: ብዝኀት — and abundance (ወ- + noun, fem.; construct 'abundance of')
glossary.ወተዐርግ: ዐርገ — and it goes up (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ወተዐዲ: ዐደወ — and it crosses (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G, ʿ-d-w)
glossary.ወትትኃለፍ: ኀለፈ — and it passes along (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, tä-stem of ኀለፈ 'pass') (?)
glossary.ወትወርድ: ወረደ — and it goes down (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G, w-r-d); the second ወ is part of the root
glossary.ወነሥአ: ነሥአ — and he took (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወነበረ: ነበረ — and he stayed, remained (ወ- + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ወነበሩ: ነበረ — and they stayed, lived (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, n-b-r)
glossary.ወነበቡ: ነበበ — and they spoke (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, n-b-b)
glossary.ወነፍኁ: ነፍሐ — and they blew (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወንሖር: ሖረ — and let us go (ወ- 'and' + 1cp jussive, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወንኡሳን: ንኡስ — and the small ones (ወ- + adjective as noun, plural ንኡሳን)
glossary.ወንገኒ: ገነየ — and we bow to, worship (ወ- + 1cp imperfect, G, g-n-y, with ለ-; spelled ንገኒ for ንግነይ) (?)
glossary.ወአሕሠምዋ: አሕሠመ — and he spoiled it, corrupted it (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, ḥ-ś-m + -ዋ '3fs it')
glossary.ወአምጽኡ: አምጽአ — and they brought (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of መጽአ)
glossary.ወአስሐቶሙ: አስሐተ — and he led them astray (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, s-ḥ-t + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወአስማት: ስም — and names (ወ- + plural አስማት of ስም)
glossary.ወአስኔት: አስኔት — and Asnet (ወ- + proper name, unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወአንስት: ብእሲት — and women (ወ- + plural አንስት of ብእሲት)
glossary.ወአንሶሰወ: አንሶሰወ — and it roamed, wandered about (ወ- + 3ms perfect, quadriliteral, n-s-s-w)
glossary.ወአንበሩ: አንበረ — and they set, placed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ነበረ)
glossary.ወአንበርዎን: አንበረ — and they set them up, placed them (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ነበረ + -ዎን '3fp them')
glossary.ወአንጋዲሆሙ: አንጋድ — obscure noun, perhaps relatives or associates (plural + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; ወ- 'and'; uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወአወፈዩነ: አወፈየ — and they gave us, handed on to us (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወኢያእመሩ: አእመረ — and they did not know (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp perfect, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
glossary.ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወዐርገ: ዐርገ — and he ascended (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ወዐቢዮሙ: ዐቢይ — and their great ones, the great of them (ወ- + adjective as noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወዕሩቃን: ዕሩቅ — and the naked ones (ወ- + plural ዕሩቃን of ዕሩቅ 'naked'; apparently a people, beside ጸሊማን) (?)
glossary.ወዕንዚራ: ዕንዚራ — and ዕንዚራ (?) (ወ- + noun; a stringed instrument, perhaps a harp or lyre) (?)
glossary.ወይባሶ: ይባሶ — and Yibaso (ወ- + proper name, unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወይፀርፉ: ጸረፈ — and they blaspheme (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ṣ-r-f)
glossary.ወይፈድዮ: ፈደየ — and he repays (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G ይፈድይ + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወደየ: ወደየ — he put, placed (3ms perfect, G, w-d-y); ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
glossary.ወጸላኤ: ጸላኢ — and hater (ወ- + noun, construct 'hater of')
glossary.ወጸሐፍዎን: ጸሐፈ — and they wrote them (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ṣ-ḥ-f + -ዎን '3fp them')
glossary.ወፌኔቄንሃ: ፌኔቄ — and Phoenicia (ወ- + proper name; the ending -ንሃ is unexplained, perhaps a suffix or a variant form) (?)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውስጥ: ውስጥ — inside, within (adverb / noun; ሰብአ ውስጥ 'men of the inside, insiders')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዓመት: ዓመት — year (noun, fem.; after a numeral)
glossary.ዕድዉ: ዕድው — enemy, adversary (noun; elsewhere ዕድው is 'man', ዕደው 'men' in ch. 35, which does not suit ዕድዉ ለሰብእ, so 'enemy' is guessed from context) (?)
glossary.ዕፍረተ: ዕፍረት — perfume, ointment (noun, fem.; construct 'perfume of')
glossary.ዘለሊሆሙ: ለሊሁ — of themselves, they themselves (ዘ- + reflexive pronoun ለሊሁ + -ሆሙ '3mp')
glossary.ዘሎቱ: ለ — to whom, whose (ዘ- + preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
glossary.ዘበሕግ: ሕግ — lawful, by law (ዘ- relative + በ- + noun; 'one of law')
glossary.ዘተገብረ: ተገብረ — which was done (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ዘአማሰኑ: አማሰነ — those who ruined (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, causative, ʾ-m-s-n)
glossary.ዘአውፅአት: አውፅአ — who brought out (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, causative of ወፅአ)
glossary.ዘእምትካት: ትካት — who from of old (ዘ- + እም- 'from' + ትካት 'establishment, foundation'; cf. እምትካት ch. 44, ዘትካት ch. 30; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — whom God (made king, etc.) (ዘ- 'the one whom' + noun as subject of the following verb; ዘእግዚኣብሔር አንገሠ 'whom God made king') · 'of God', ዘ- as genitive marker after a noun (ቤተ ክርስቲያን ዘእግዚኣብሔር 'the church of God')
glossary.ዘወደየ: ወደየ — what he put, the thing he put (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, w-d-y)
glossary.ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
glossary.ዝውእቱ: ውእቱ — this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
glossary.የሐውሩ: ሖረ — they go (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.የዐርግ: ዐርገ — he goes up (3ms imperfect, G, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ይቅትል: ቀተለ — that he kill (3ms subjunctive, G, q-t-l)
glossary.ይበጽሕ: በጽሐ — he/it reaches (3ms imperfect, G, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ይቤዝዎ: ቤዘወ — that he redeem him (3ms subjunctive, G, b-z-w + -ዎ '3ms him'; ለአዳም names the one redeemed)
glossary.ይትዐወቅ: ተዐወቀ — it is known (3ms imperfect, passive tG-stem of ዐወቀ)
glossary.ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ይከይድ: ከይደ — he walks, goes, treads (3ms imperfect, G, k-y-d; perfect ከይደ, spelled ኬደ in ch. 24) (?)
glossary.ይኴንን: ኰነነ — he rule, judge (3ms imperfect/jussive, D)
glossary.ይውሕኩ: ወሐከ — they mock, slander (3mp imperfect; the lemma is reconstructed from the imperfect and not found in the lexicon, so form and sense are uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-) · his servant (ገብር + -ሁ '3ms his', ለዳዊት ገብሩ 'to David his servant') · they made (3mp perfect of ገብረ, G, g-b-r; ገብሩ አህጉረ 'they made cities')
glossary.ጥንተ: ጥንት — beginning, origin (noun; construct 'beginning of'; adverbial accusative 'starting at')
glossary.ጸራ: ጸር — enemies, adversaries (noun) (?); the form ጸራ (4th-order ending) is not the plain accusative ጸረ, so its parse is uncertain (?)
glossary.ጸናዕነ: ጸንዐ — we stood firm (1cp perfect, G, ṣ-n-ʿ)
glossary.ፌኔኤል: ፌኔኤል — Phenuel (proper name; Peniel (Genesis 32:30) or Phoenicia) (?)
glossary.፫አውራኀ: ወርኅ — three months (numeral ፫, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three', written on the plural noun አውራኀ of ወርኅ)
glossary.፮: ፮ — 6, spoken ስድስቱ (sədstu) 'six'; chapter number (numeral) · count: ፮ ዓመተ 'six years', ፮ ሲሕ 'six thousand (?)' · ordinal date, አመ ፮ 'on the sixth (day)', read as the ordinal (?)
glossary.፺፪: ፺፪ — 92, spoken ተስዓ ወክልኤቱ (täsʿa wä-kəlʾetu) 'ninety-two'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፺፫: ፺፫ — 93, spoken ተስዓ ወሠለስቱ (täsʿa wä-śälästu) 'ninety-three'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፻ወ፴: ፻ወ፴ — 130, spoken ምእት ወሠላሳ (məʾət wä-śälasa) 'a hundred and thirty'; count before ዓመት (numeral)
